title: rest: on the hosted multi-environment runtime the /approvals routes read the HOST kernel, so an environment's approval requests never reach the inbox (list answers [], a request answers 501)
body:
coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_6eb9ec2e0e3f410b91239dab7a337b9e

Filing gate: **① a defect found in a run** (cloud#3305 staging acceptance, Team rerun, 2026-11-04).

Reader: the `domain:rest` / runtime lane. The fix site is very likely framework code (`packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts` and `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`), but the failure only shows up on a host that runs one REST plugin in front of many environment kernels (cloud's objectos runtime). Suggested priority p1: it blocks cloud#3305 observation 1f, and through it cloud#3307, #3308, #3309 and #3311. Triage decides.

Dedupe:
- objectstack `approvals service is not configured`: 2 hits. #26632 (closed) is the console noise on deployments with no approvals service at all. #26629 (closed) is a QA run. Neither is this.
- objectstack `approvalsServiceProvider`: 3 hits, all closed. #14251 is about the three-state `ctx.getService` throw. #17716 is a test-table count. #23050 is the rest-server split. None is about which kernel the provider reads.
- cloud `approvals service is not configured`, `approval inbox empty`: 0.

## 维护者速读

在 staging 的 Team 环境上，审批流已经跑起来，审批请求也写进了库，可是审批人在界面上看不到：「审批中心」和首页的「待审批」都是空的，也就没法批准或驳回。原因是托管运行时只有一个 REST 插件，挂在宿主内核上，而审批接口是从宿主内核取审批服务。审批服务在环境内核里，宿主那边没有，于是列表接口返回空，单条请求接口返回 501。数据接口没有这个问题，因为它会按环境去找对应的内核。

## What was seen (staging, cloud `419ee51b`, objectstack 18.3.0 `83d7e4ae`)

Environment `os-4e4qa4.objectos.app` (test1016, plan `team`, no installed package). Through the MCP build door, an approval flow `m3305_approval` was drafted: record-after-create on `mcp3305_m3305_request`, an `approval` node with approver `org_membership_level: owner`, and `approve` / `reject` out-edges to two `update_record` steps. A human published it in Studio. A record was then created in the UI at 01:38:48.466Z.

| Read, as the approver (session cookie, the request's `pending_approvers`) | Answer |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request` | 200: `areq_bcb78e81-…`, `status: pending`, `process_name: flow:m3305_approval`, `current_step: owner_approval`, `pending_approvers` = the caller, created 01:38:48.949Z |
| `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=pending&approverId=<caller>` (what the Approvals inbox and the home 「待审批」 card call) | 200 `{"data":[]}` |
| `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` (no filter) | 200 `{"data":[]}` |
| `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_bcb78e81-…` | **501** `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, 「Approvals service is not configured on this deployment」 |
| Console 「审批中心 › 待我审批」 | 「暂无请求」 |
| Home 「我的工作」 | the notifications card shows 「Approval requested」, but the 「待审批」 card shows 「没有待审批的事项」 |

So the engine side works: the flow ran, the `approval` executor created the request and paused the run. Only the HTTP door cannot see the service that holds the request.

## Why (from the code at the pin)

- `rest-api-plugin.ts:420`: `approvalsServiceProvider = async (_environmentId) => ctx.getService('approvals')`. The environment id is ignored, and `ctx` is the context of the kernel the REST plugin was mounted on.
- cloud mounts `createRestApiPlugin` once, on the host kernel (`apps/objectos/server/index.ts:307`). `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` registers `approvals` on the environment kernel (`approvals-plugin.ts:397`, `ctx.registerService('approvals', …)`). The host kernel has no such service.
- `approvals-routes.ts:105`: `resolveService` answers `undefined`. The list route maps that to `{"data":[]}` on purpose (line ~244, so badge polls stay quiet), and the single-request routes map it to 501.
- The protocol path does not have this problem: the same plugin resolves a per-environment protocol through `kernel-manager` / `kernel-resolver` (lines 165–260). The other env-blind providers in the same block (`emailServiceProvider`, `sharingServiceProvider`, `sharingRulesServiceProvider`, `analyticsServiceProvider`) have the same shape. **Not verified** on staging whether they are reachable and break the same way; listed so the fix can decide its scope.
- On an unscoped (hostname) route, `approvals-routes.ts` also passes `environmentId = undefined` (`isScoped ? req.params.environmentId : undefined`). A provider that honours the id still needs the request's environment from the same resolver the protocol path uses.

## Done when

On a hosted environment kernel that mounts approvals, `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` lists the environment's own requests for its approver, the single-request and decide routes reach the environment's service, and a request from one environment is never served from another (or from the host). A test in the host-in-front-of-environments shape covers it (cloud's `tenant-kernel-e2e.fixture.ts` mounts `createRestApiPlugin` on a host the same way). Then cloud#3305 1f is rerun.

Not changed by this run: the request `areq_bcb78e81-…` is still pending on staging (record `maE8uJJ54buTmy5m` stays locked), so it can be used to check the fix.
